ip_eyebrow: Know your network before using Claude
ip_intro: Inspect the connection reaching this site, its region and network organization, with clear limits. No sign-in, account details or keys required.
ip_error: Check failed. Verify your connection and retry. No result does not mean safe.
ip_mask_note: IP is partially masked by default. Keep it masked in screenshots.
ip_limited: Basic check complete; some signals remain unknown
ip_incomplete_body: Complete edge metadata is unavailable. This can happen in local previews, non-Cloudflare deployments or some networks. We never substitute the server IP for yours.
ip_region_body: The detected region is not in the referenced list or has territorial exceptions. Review the official policy. IP location is not physical location or proof of account eligibility.
ip_hosting_body: The provider or organization rules indicate hosting characteristics. This is not a ban verdict. Browser sign-in and API workloads on cloud servers are different contexts.
ip_limited_body: Read the score together with its source and signals. A score of 100 only means no scoring deductions were triggered in this check; it does not certify safety, residential identity or immunity from bans.
ip_next_body: Review official regional requirements and check whether this page and Claude use the same network route. If eligibility or sign-in remains unclear, pause the purchase and contact support rather than retrying sign-in or payment.
ip_source: Primary source: IPQuery. If unavailable, proxycheck.io provides a free fallback, capped at 80 fallback queries per day. Normalized results are cached for 10 minutes. No account, order or key is accepted. Unavailable evidence never produces a safety score.
ip_policy_date: Reference list checked: {date}; current official policy takes precedence
ip_timezone_note: Read locally, not uploaded. Travel, remote desktops and preferences can cause mismatches. Timezone is not scored and cannot establish why an account was banned.
ip_webrtc_note: No probe runs by default. Clicking contacts Google’s public STUN service, which sees your connection IP. Results stay on this page. Different addresses may reflect dual-stack or routing, not necessarily a leak.
ip_webrtc_empty: No public candidate was available. Browser privacy or network blocking may hide it; this does not prove absence of leaks.
ip_webrtc_unavailable: WebRTC is unavailable or the check could not complete.
ip_webrtc_found: Public candidates (masked by default; ownership not verified)
ip_g1_title: 01 / What can this check tell you?
ip_g1_body: It observes your browser’s connection to this site, not what Claude sees. Proxy rules, extensions, IPv4/IPv6 and separate clients can use different exits. Check on the intended device and network, and recheck after changes.
ip_g2_body: Start at 100 and apply detected signals: hosting risk 33, VPN 50, Tor 75, residential proxy 100, plus 25 for the associated-cloud rule; risk is capped at 100. Hosting purity is capped at 60, some anonymizers at 40, and some regions at 5 or 40. Incomplete evidence is explicitly labeled an edge estimate.
ip_g3_title: 03 / Region, network and account are separate
ip_g3_body: Regional availability concerns eligibility; network type is a connection characteristic. Account access and billing require separate checks. A listed region does not establish compliance with all terms. This page does not access accounts, orders, recharge status or subscriptions.
ip_g4_title: 04 / Local settings a website cannot read
ip_g4_body: A webpage cannot read shell variables, system proxies or Claude Code settings. The optional read-only commands below report presence without printing keys or proxy URLs. Existing proxy settings are not necessarily wrong. Do not blindly clear them or share configuration files, account tokens or full command output.
ip_g5_body: An IP check is not payment clearance and does not replace subscription, unpaid-bill and account checks on the product page. Resolve issues before ordering. Clicking check never creates an order, charges you or sends a notification.
ip_footnote: Independent implementation · diagnostic reference, not an official Anthropic tool
ip_score_note: Higher means fewer signals under these rules, not a ban probability or safety guarantee
ip_score_edge: Edge estimate · threat intelligence not verified
ip_grade_caution: Review how this network is used
ip_rank: Above {percent}% of this site’s checks in 30 days · {count} samples
ip_query_notice: Checks send the target public IP to IPQuery and, if needed, proxycheck.io. Opening the page checks the current exit. Only the IP is sent, not account or order information.
ip_query_other: This report is for a specified IP, not your current connection
ip_provider_warning: The check is unavailable or rate-limited. Basic network information is retained; retry manually later. Missing intelligence will not be shown as a score of 100.

ip_article_title: Claude network guide: region, IP, client and scoring
ip_article_intro: Understand the evidence behind a score, its gaps, and what to check before purchasing.
ip_a1_title: Regional eligibility is more than an IP country
ip_a1_body: Availability depends on Anthropic’s official list and terms. IP geolocation is an estimate, not proof of physical presence or account/company eligibility. Territorial exceptions require manual review; a country code alone is insufficient. We flag these cases rather than recommending fabricated eligibility.
ip_a2_title: Residential, hosting, VPN and proxy are different concepts
ip_a2_body: An ASN identifies an autonomous network and its organization identifies the operator. These can indicate hosting but do not establish exclusive use. Residential proxies can run on real home connections, and Tor, VPN, proxy and hosting signals can overlap. A country label or provider name alone is not enough.
ip_a3_title: Reputation data has age and uncertainty
ip_a3_body: IPQuery supplies hosting, VPN, proxy, Tor, mobile flags and risk, with one proxycheck.io fallback if needed. We keep the more conservative local/provider risk. Not detected describes this result, not all time. Anycast checks cover published common public DNS addresses only. Other addresses and ASN abuse fractions remain unknown; combined risk is not an abuse fraction.
ip_a4_title: Client and request signals: observations versus hypotheses
ip_a4_body: A browser can read its timezone, language and some WebRTC candidates, not shell variables or Claude Code configuration. Claims about information encoded in requests require version-specific code and reproducible evidence. Community articles are not Anthropic’s enforcement rules. We do not claim a timezone, cloud organization or alleged fingerprint proves why an account was suspended.
ip_a5_title: WebRTC and routing: different addresses need interpretation
ip_a5_body: Web traffic, UDP, IPv4 and IPv6 may take different routes. Additional public candidates can reflect dual-stack or routing and require network ownership checks. Missing candidates can reflect blocked STUN or browser privacy. Google STUN runs only after your explicit click; candidates are not uploaded and failed probes do not become no-leak verdicts.
ip_a6_title: Local read-only checks: protect secrets and avoid blind changes
ip_a6_body: Compare browser and client routes, then check whether proxy variables or a custom ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL are set. Presence checks are enough; do not share values, configuration files or tokens. Proxies may be required for legitimate work, so do not blindly delete them. Back up settings before making deliberate network changes.
ip_a7_title: Before purchase: network checks do not replace account checks
ip_a7_body: Check on the intended device and network, review regional requirements and deductions, then verify account access, existing subscriptions and billing/refund issues. Contact support when uncertain instead of repeating recharges, payments or sign-ins. Use the masked share card and never include account details.
ip_a8_body: Only the target public IP is sent, not accounts or orders. Normalized facts are cached under hashed keys for 10 minutes; rate-limit keys expire after at most about 48 hours. Rankings display 30-day site score aggregates, counted at most once per IP per day, not a global ranking. Share images contain masked IPs, time, source, score and the site QR, never accounts, orders or tokens.
ip_article_credit: Independently written by Laoshiren VIP, informed by leeguoo’s network-detection topic. Scoring is adapted from the author’s MIT code with its license retained. This is not a verbatim republication or official enforcement guidance.
ip_clear_body: The source currently reports no obvious anonymizer risk. Review the timestamp, regional requirements and coverage gaps. A high score cannot guarantee that an account will not be suspended.
ip_risk_body: VPN, proxy, Tor or elevated reputation risk was detected. Review network use and service requirements. A score is not clearance to sign in, recharge or pay.
ip_timezone_mismatch: Browser and IP database timezones differ; consider travel, routing or remote environments
ip_timezone_no_conflict: No timezone difference observed, or comparison data is unavailable; not scored
ip_browser_scope: Browser checks below always concern this device, not an arbitrary remote IP queried above.
ip_anycast_note: Anycast matches only published common public DNS addresses. No match means uncovered, not non-anycast. ASN abuse fraction is unavailable.
ip_coverage_body: Automatic: public IP, country/city, ASN/organization, hosting, VPN, proxy, Tor, mobile and risk. Residential proxy is inferred. Timezone and WebRTC are browser checks. System proxies, shell variables and tool settings require local review. These are limited external sources, not Anthropic internal enforcement results.

promotion_title: Invite friends and earn shopping rewards
promotion_rules: Friends get a discount with your invitation code, and you earn shopping rewards. Rewards become available from 00:00 Beijing time on the day after delivery, cannot be withdrawn, and may be reversed after refunds.

promotion_error: Unable to complete this action. Check permissions and eligibility, then retry.

promotion_coupon_error: Coupon unavailable, not applicable, or belongs to another account. Clear it or use a different code.

promotion_no_recipients: No eligible customers in this preview
